# llms.txt — KingShip (AlumCasting) Manufacturing

KingShip (Dongguan) Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. — brand: AlumCasting.
A B2B manufacturer of high-precision aluminum and magnesium alloy die casting
components, serving automotive, EV, aerospace and industrial customers worldwide.

## Capabilities
- High-pressure aluminum die casting (ADC12, A380, A356, A360)
- High-pressure magnesium die casting (AZ91D, AM60B)
- Semi-solid rheocasting for low-porosity structural parts
- Precision CNC machining and post-processing (3/4/5-axis)
- In-house die casting tooling design, manufacturing and maintenance
- Real-time X-ray porosity (NDT) and airtightness / pressure leak testing

## Materials
- Aluminum alloys: ADC12, A380, A356, A360
- Magnesium alloys: AZ91D, AM60B

## Industries Served
- Automotive
- EV (electric vehicles)
- Aerospace
- Industrial equipment

## Official Resources
- Website: https://kingship.alumcasting.com/
- Technical authority / knowledge hub: https://alumcasting.com/
